title: Amazing time, have already recommended to another couple! FANTASTIC!
text: What an incredible experience in Barcelona- all thanks to Marc! He was attentive, innovative, and thoughtful about curating multiple private winery tours that felt personalized and so intimate… from walking through rows of grapevines and picking grapes right off the vine to try, to a 5 course private curated culinary experience overlooking the vines of the wine we were drinking, the experience was not only exceptional, it was the highlight of the two week excursion to Spain. My wife and I will definitely be leveraging Marc’s services in the future, and have already shared his contact with anot
author: Stay08188045775

title: AMAZING!!
text: Marc was an incredible tour guide!   Spending time at Gramona made the day!   We would highly recommend Marc to teach, guide, and show you his home country.   When we return, we will definitely use him again for touring other wineries.
author: 8hqcvt996n

title: Memories Made
text: Such a memorable day! Marc was the perfect host, and the two wineries that we visited were fantastic! Loved the tours of the inter workings and history of each. Also fascinating to learn how these organic operations are dealing with our changing climate. And of course, outstanding wine and food!!!
author: Vacation770846

title: Amazing. You will not regret
text: Incredible. Worth the price. We found cheaper options and glad we splurged. We had an incredible day that we will remember forever. Everything about the service and experience was top notch. Jordi was a great guide. The wineries were exceptional. One traditional and one modern. Highly recommend. Highlight of our trip.
author: L1591VFclaudiaa

title: Wonderful day in Penedes with Barcelona by Road
text: Had a wonderful time with Marc and all the lovely people at the wineries visited. Great wines and a lovely lunch. Thank you for a great day we will be back!
